file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/51-12/1_51-12_init.xlsx'

# Data range A1 to M1

values = [100, 105, 110, 200, 220, 250, 260, 275, 160, 175, 170, 177, 100.1]

# Logic:
# Count number of times a value increases by at least 10% from a reference cell.
# Start from A1. Reference cell is the current starting cell.
# If a value increases by >= 10% compared to the reference, increment count and restart reference from the cell immediately to the right.
# If not, move to the next cell and check against the same reference.

count = 0
i = 0
while i < len(values):
    reference_val = values[i]
    # Look for the first value to the right that is >= 110% of reference_val
    found = False
    for j in range(i + 1, len(values)):
        if values[j] >= reference_val * 1.1:
            count += 1
            # Restart counting process from the cell immediately right of the found cell
            i = j + 1
            found = True
            break
    if not found:
        # No more increases found in the remaining range
        break

# Verification of the logic on the provided data:
# 1. Ref = 100 (A1). 
#    - 105 (B1): 105/100 = 1.05 (< 1.1)
#    - 110 (C1): 110/100 = 1.1 (>= 1.1) -> COUNT = 1.
#    - Restart from D1.
# 2. Ref = 200 (D1).
#    - 220 (E1): 220/200 = 1.1 (>= 1.1) -> COUNT = 2.
#    - Restart from F1.
# 3. Ref = 250 (F1).
#    - 260 (G1): 260/250 = 1.04 (< 1.1)
#    - 275 (H1): 275/250 = 1.1 (>= 1.1) -> COUNT = 3.
#    - Restart from I1.
# 4. Ref = 160 (I1).
#    - 175 (J1): 175/160 = 1.09375 (< 1.1)
#    - 170 (K1): 170/160 = 1.0625 (< 1.1)
#    - 177 (L1): 177/160 = 1.10625 (>= 1.1) -> COUNT = 4.
#    - Restart from M1.
# 5. Ref = 100.1 (M1).
#    - No more cells to the right.
# Final Count = 4.

# Write the result to B6
sheet['B6'] = count

# Save the workbook
